title: A Group Project
story: Hana, Felix, and Omar had to prepare a short talk about their town for history class. They met in an empty classroom after lunch and closed the door so they could think. Hana opened a folder and spread three pages of notes on the table. Felix had photos of the old market on his phone, and Omar had a map he had drawn at home. At first they all spoke at once, and nobody wrote anything down. Hana asked them to take turns. She said the talk could last only five minutes, so each person needed one clear part. Omar offered to explain the map. Hana offered to begin and to end the talk. They wrote a simple plan in the folder and numbered the steps. Omar pointed at the map and spoke too fast, so Hana tapped the table and he slowed down. Felix forgot a date, and Omar found it in the notes. They practised the whole talk twice. The second time it fitted the five minutes and sounded calm. Before they left, Hana checked that every photo and the map were in the folder. Felix promised to charge his phone. Omar promised to bring the folder in the morning so nobody would leave it behind. The teacher smiled when the talk finished on time. The three friends learned that a plan and a little patience can turn a noisy group into a team.
